thread_dispositions.reply_body: Missing gateway/window and PNG encoding failures now set session.notice, using the existing result alert. The selected headless Simulator capture test passes and the gateway saved one PNG/frame capture.

A width/column change now updates rows even while the composer or keyboard is active; a keyboard-only height change retains the PTY rows. The headless Simulator test queries the actual fixture PTY grid before keyboard display and after rotation; it passes.

Gateway preserves an explicit HTTPS scheme, preserves explicit ports, and rejects schemes other than HTTP/HTTPS. The native Foundation URL probe passes bare-host, HTTP, HTTPS and unsupported-scheme cases. This is URL-construction evidence, not a new live TLS deployment qualification.

Retaining NSAllowsLocalNetworking for the documented Tailscale transport. That ATS flag is not server authentication; changing it does not authenticate an arbitrary LAN endpoint. The documented contract now explicitly requires active Tailscale and a trusted configured gateway. The gateway binds its own tailnet address and checks same-owner iOS whois identity, Host and Origin; arbitrary LAN endpoints are outside that contract. Explicit HTTPS is preserved separately. No claim of arbitrary LAN endpoint authentication is made.
resize and claimSize now share sendResize for the wire payload. The background terminal-input cases exercise size claims; normal, ASan/UBSan and TSan runs pass, with scoped static analysis clean.

begin now resets shown_size_ and claimed_over_ with the rest of the attachment state. This removes stale bookkeeping without relying on the initial forced resize. Background input/reconnect/size-claim checks pass under normal, ASan/UBSan and TSan builds.
Moved the wrapped-link comment back immediately above links_follow_wrapped_rows. The size-claim test retains its own description.

AgentView now records an actual background transition and reopens only on the corresponding return to active. A brief inactive-to-active transition preserves the healthy stream and history. Swift typecheck and the four selected Simulator cases pass; an actual Control Center transition was not separately automated.

AgentSession now drains a single bounded input queue. One request completes before the next begins, including compound paste/Enter, and close invalidates the queue epoch and cancels the active task. A native HTTP probe confirms ordered rapid sends and cancellation of pending input; the Simulator typing/key case passes.

Immutable history pages now retain wrapped rows in a per-view cache keyed by load identity and fitting width; live rows render separately. Reloaded page numbers receive new identities so reconnects cannot reuse stale content. The Simulator scrollback and rotation cases pass. No performance percentile claim is made.

History accessibility text is cached with the page set, and the combined value is rebuilt only when the history or live text changes. This preserves screen-reader and XCTest access without repeatedly traversing every history line on unrelated body evaluations. The Simulator history case passes; latency is not newly benchmarked.

A cursor on a wide-tail cell now emits an explicit cursor overlay while retaining the wide glyph run at its full two-cell width. The regression places the cursor on the tail and checks the following glyph column; the gateway suite passes.

Snapshot decoding rejects out-of-range Unicode scalars and surrogates before rendering. History rendering is inside its GatewayError boundary, so malformed archived data returns a 502 diagnostic. Regression payloads cover both invalid scalar classes.

Gateway resize validation now enforces columns*rows <= 32768 before sending the wire request. The focused boundary regression refuses an oversized grid and accepts a valid large grid; the gateway suite passes.
The runner shuts down only the simulator UUID it booted. Review verification used a separately created disposable simulator and deleted only that fixture afterward; no shutdown-all call remains.

Device discovery now distinguishes command failure, timeout, malformed output and multiple reachable phones with actionable diagnostics. The temporary JSON is always removed. Focused tests cover none/one/multiple devices and each failure class without installing anything.

Covered by the discovery repair: multiple reachable iPhones now produce an explicit --device selection diagnostic instead of the no-phone connectivity message. The none/one/multiple regression passes.
Removed the unused time.time_ns patch. Server fixtures that allocate their own temporary directory now register its cleanup. The gateway suite passes.

Authentication now rejects a draining session with an ended status before either join or takeover activates. A live probe holds an incomplete attachment, ends the owner process, then completes authentication; both modes receive ended under normal, ASan/UBSan and TSan services.

Snapshot publication now logs the affected view ID and exception diagnostic before dropping the view. Scoped clang-tidy/Cppcheck and the instrumented live gateway checks pass; overflow itself was not artificially induced.

limitations: No merge into main performed. Optional reviewer availability is separate from required repository gates.
macOS remains the qualified desktop target; no Linux qualification in this pass.
Simulator and synthetic loopback Tailscale status do not prove physical iPhone or real tailnet admission.
No new latency percentile or VoiceOver-device qualification.
A default Cocoa input attempt observed host interference; the passing input evidence uses explicit --background mode. Native OS input/GPU acceptance was not repeated.

Initial Simulator packaging and gateway-fixture failures were diagnosed before the passing final run. Sanitizer configuration reuses -Xclang -fobjc-dispatch-method=legacy for installed LLVM/Apple linker compatibility.
